narr: A weak upper level trough remained over far west Texas and combined with near record atmospheric moisture levels resulting in heavy rain across much of El Paso County resulting in flash flooding in Canutillo and around the Montana Vista area.
ev: Water flooded roads across Canutillo with at least one business near 1st Street damaged due to rapidly rising water. Several roads remained closed for hours to clean up debris.

Flash flooding occurred from near Loop 375 and Montana to areas about 11 miles northeast of Montana Vista. There was a vehicle flooded at the intersection of Montana and Dominican Street. Flooding also resulted in stranded vehicles at Joe Battle and Montana. Further east, Petty Prue Street was closed due to a washout due to an arroyo filled up and caused damage to a low water crossing.
